[[File:CheAmanweBadass-SoI.png|thumb|right|250px|Che Amanwe Papanoida with an appropriated Weequay pistol]]
A type of '''blaster pistol''' was used by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and various others throughout the galaxy during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] commonly fired [[Color/Legends|red]] blaster bolts, though Hondo Ohnaka used one that fired blue bolts. It was a very common blaster in the underworld as it was seen in the hands of numerous criminals and bounty hunters during the Clone Wars and was even carried by a [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion|Neimoidian guard]] aboard a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]].

==History==
The [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] was utilized by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when [[Gender/Legends|he]] was disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] and by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] bounty hunter [[Bulduga/Legends|Bulduga]], who tried to use it against fellow hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrick]], the treacherous [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]], used one when he took [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] hostage aboard her ship, the ''[[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]]'', and used it to murder four [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]]s and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gray (Coronet captain)/Legends|Gray]].

==Behind the scenes==
The weapon is not identified by name in any canonical source, but it has similarities with DL-series pistols like [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol|DL-18 blaster pistol]] or [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]]. The pistol used by [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrick]] was identified as a [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 blaster pistol]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' although it does not bear much similarity to [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] LL-30 blaster pistols.
